description_en: Queries the information about SQL statements that are involved in the precheck of a data change ticket
description_zh: 获取数据变更工单中预检查环节的SQL信息列表
name: ListDataCorrectPreCheckSQL

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data change ticket. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html operation to query the ID of the data change ticket
parameters.help_zh: 数据变更工单ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the database. The database can be a physical database or a logical database.

To query the ID of a physical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation.
To query the ID of a logical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
数据库ID（DatabaseId），数据库分为物理库和逻辑库两种：
物理库ID：可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值。
逻辑库ID：可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to query the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

PreCheckSQLList.description_en: The precheck information about SQL statements
PreCheckSQLList.description_zh: 预检查环节的SQL信息列表

AffectRows.description_en: The estimated number of affected rows

SQLReviewQueryKey.description_en: The key that is used to query the details of optimization suggestions. You can call the [GetSQLReviewOptimizeDetail]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265977.html） operation to query the details of optimization suggestions based on the key
SQLReviewQueryKey.description_zh: SQL审核优化建议详情信息的查询KEY。根据此Key调用[GetSQLReviewOptimizeDetail]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265977.html）获取SQL审核优化建议的详情

SqlReviewStatus.description_en:
The review status of the SQL statement. Valid values:

WAITING: The SQL statement is pending for review.
RUNNING: The SQL statement is being reviewed.
IGNORE: The SQL statement review is skipped.
PASS: The SQL statement passed the review.
BLOCK: The SQL statement failed the review
SqlReviewStatus.description_zh:
SQL审核状态，返回值如下：
WAITING：等待审核。
RUNNING：正在审核。
IGNORE：忽略审核。
PASS：审核通过。
BLOCK：审核不通过

SqlType.description_en: The type of the SQL statement, such as DELETE, UPDATE, or ALTER_TABLE

TableNames.description_en: The name of the table whose data is changed

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
